v1.35.3 (13 October 2024) |feed_title = Bug Fixes |feed_color = Purple |previous_update = [[v1.34.0|Stickers Update]] |next_update = [[v1.36.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.35.0''' is the eighty-eighth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 9th of October 2024. It had a few small changes and bugfixes. This update encompassed seven versions, the main v1.35.0 (released 9 October 2024) and six minor updates, the v1.35.1 (released 10 October 2024), v1.35.1a (released 11 October 2024), v1.35.1b (released 11 October 2024), v1.35.1c (released 11 October 2024), v1.35.2 (released 12 October 2024) and v1.35.3 (released 13 October 2024). ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode wave structure changed. *Enabled the usage of {{ReviveTicket|Revive Tickets}}. *Revives updated. **Reviving now sets the base health to what it was at the start of the wave players revive from, instead of it healing itself fully every time. **Fixed modes which require the match to be started by players from having an infinite timer after reviving. **Partially fixed revives giving rewards every time a match ends in a loss or triumph. *Waves which have their timer set to be infinite now cannot be skipped. *Fixed [[DJ Booth]] calculating if sold towers should be buffed. *Fixed tower debuffs updating on dead enemies. *Fixed [[Mercenary Base]] placement breaking when trying to access an invalid path. *Fixed [[Lazy Couch]] and [[Recliner]] emotes sometimes being tilted upon joining. *Fixed [[Frozen (Emote)|Frozen]] emote ice cube sometimes not appearing when used. *Fixed [[Axe Throw]] emote not throwing its axe. *Fixed [[Gunslinger]]'s ''Crossbone Crossfire'' ability bullet trails not appearing. *Fixed emotes in the emote wheel playing sounds. :In '''v1.35.1''': *Fixed not being able to skip waves in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] and [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] modes. :In '''v1.35.1a''': *Moved some changes from the TDS Experimental game to the main game. :In '''v1.35.1b''': *Fixed [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Ace Pilot]] using TDS Experimental game statistics during matches. :In '''v1.35.1c''': *Fixed [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Ace Pilot]] using TDS Experimental game statistics in the lobby. :In '''v1.35.2''': *Fixed [[Gatling Gun]] breaking while it is made to shoot slower, such as through [[Time Scale]] set to anything below 1x, making it no longer shoot. :In '''v1.35.3''': *When [[Time Scale]] is set to anything lower than 0.0005x, abilities can no longer be used. *[[Slasher]] gamepass taken offsale. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.35.0Thumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} V1.35.0UpdateIcon.png }} ==Official Update Log==
